C0812.title: European Commission Confirms Data Breach from Trivy Supply Chain Attack
C0812.summary: CERT-EU disclosed that the European Commission detected abnormal alerts involving an AWS account on March 24, 2026, notified CERT-EU on March 25, and publicly disclosed the incident on March 27. CERT-EU assessed that initial access came from the Trivy supply chain compromise attributed to TeamPCP, and that about 91.7 GB of compressed data was exfiltrated from the affected AWS account, including personal data such as names, email addresses, and email content.

references.title: European Commission cloud breach: a supply-chain compromise
